name: com.mycore.notificationkit
description: A reusable Unity local notification module (iOS + Android) with an optional, separately-gated Firebase push sub-feature. No singleton: a plain NotificationScheduler engine the app owns, a thin NotificationHost MonoBehaviour for lifecycle, and an INotificationExecutor seam. Zero game-specific dependencies.

samples.description: Generic usage example + a game-specific executor template (guarded by NOTIFICATIONKIT_SAMPLES).
